source_text: This product is a high-tech infra-red (IR) thermometer designed to take human body temperature by measuring the energy of IR emitted from the forehead. The product will help you to assess you and your family members’ health conditions easily and quickly.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages. It can be used by consumers in the household environment and by healthcare providers.

source_text: □ Use of this thermometer is not intended as a substitute for consultation with your physician. Please consult your doctor if you have any doubt about the temperature reading.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Keep the thermometer out of reach of children. For accidental swallowing of the battery or other components, please contact emergency services immediately.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 1\. Thermometer readings should be regarded as a reference. Do not attempt self-diagnostics or self-treatment using the temperature readings. Please seek professional medical advice when necessary.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 2\. There is no absolute standard for human body temperature. Knowing your own normal body temperature range is important to accurately determine if you have a fever.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 4\. After showering, bathing, exercising, and eating, wait for 30 minutes before taking a measurement. Temperature readings taken when a body is in a state of stable equilibrium is more accurate and useful as a reference.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (5) Do not take temperature measurement over scar tissue, open sores or abrasions as such tissues will affect temperature conduction of the body.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (6) If there is a temperature difference between the thermometer storage area and the ambient environment around the subject, please let the thermometer sit within the subject’s ambient environment for 30 minutes before taking the measurement.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (7) Do not measure body temperature immediately after taking a medication that raises body temperature. Temperature readings taken at this time will not be accurate.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (8) It is normal for readings taken from continuous measurements to fluctuate within a small range. During continuous measurements, the subject’s body temperature may be transmitted to the thermometer, affecting measurement accuracy. We recommend taking only up to 3 continuous readings within a short period.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (9) Do not directly face the sun, an air outlet of an air conditioner or radiator device during the measurement as this will cause changes to the forehead temperature. Measurements should be taken in a stable environment where possible.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (10) Do not measure body temperature in an environment with strong electromagnetic (EM) interference (examples include places close to a working microwave, induction cooker, or cellphone in-use) as EM interference may cause errors in the reading or even device failure.

source_text: A. To measure a body's temperature, aim the thermometer probe at the center of the forehead and keep the probe 1.18 inch away from the forehead (About the same length as the first joint of your index finger). Do not touch the forehead with the probe and the thermometer should be held perpendicular to the forehead and the subject should remain steady.

source_text: B. To measure an object's temperature, aim the thermometer probe at the object to be measured. Do not touch the object with the probe.

source_text: Press and hold the button for 2 seconds to activate the dynamic measurement mode. This mode takes multiple measurements and processes them to provide accurate temperature readings, particularly useful for moving subjects like infants. A progress bar will be displayed on the screen throughout the measurement process. If you release the button before the process is complete, the result will not be displayed.

source_text: 8\. Low battery alert

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: Once switched ON for use, the thermometer will automatically detect remaining battery capacity. If battery capacity is low but adequate for measurements, the low power symbol [ ![图像15](PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html_assets/PT9L-operation guide-20240828_html_b907d908.png) ] will be displayed with the measurement results. However, if the battery capacity is too low for measurements, the screen will display a flashing [ ![图像16](PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html_assets/PT9L-operation guide-20240828_html_b907d908.png) ] icon and automatically switch OFF after 15 seconds. To continue using the device, batteries must be replaced.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (1) Press down the battery cover and slide the cover to open the battery compartment.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (3) Refer to the battery polarity symbols to orient the batteries properly during installation. Make sure that the new batteries are tightly inserted into the battery compartment and the polarity is not reversed during installation.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (4) Reinstall the battery cover to close the battery compartment.

source_text: # Temperature-taking hints

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Body temperature varies from person to person and fluctuates during the course of the day. For this reason, it is suggested to know one's normal, healthy forehead temperature to correctly determine the temperature.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Body temperature runs approximately from 95.9℉ to99.5℉(35.5℃-37.5℃). To determine if one has a fever, compare the temperature detected with the person's normal temperature. A rise over the reference body temperature of 1℉ or more is generally an indication of a fever.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: ② Allow the thermometer to dry for at least 5 minutes before taking a temperature.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: Do not put the thermometer under direct sunlight, high temperature, or moist environments. Do not allow it to come into contact with fire or harsh vibrations.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: Take out the battery if the device is not used for a month or more.

rel_path: 11 T1样机\PT9L红外体温计检测报告 V1.0.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text:
| 8 | **常温精度测试** | 环境要求：室温：23.0±2.0℃ 相对湿度：50%RH±20%RH
将恒温水槽分别设定在32℃、32.5℃、35℃、38.5℃、42℃、42.5℃、42.9℃，待恒温水槽温度稳定后，使用体温计进行测量：
1. 在断电情况下按住按键后装入电池，显示“CAL”后松开按键，产品进入黑体模式；
2. 对被测水槽连续测量三次；
3. 精度要求：≥35℃且≤42℃：±0.2℃，其它：±0.3℃。
4. 对测试结果不符合规定的温度计，可复测两次，两次复测合格，亦可作合格处理。 | 见测试记录二 | 见测试记录二 | 合格 | |

2、调整直流电源输出电压低于2.7V，此时仍可进行测量但低电符号“ ![图片 5](PT9L红外体温计检测报告 V1.0.via_lo_html_assets/PT9L红外体温计检测报告 V1.0_html_b4679e1d.png) ”将随测量结果显示；

| 10 | **背光灯** | 环境要求：室温：24℃-26℃ 相对湿度：30%-70%
将恒温水槽分别设定在34℃、35.7℃、37℃，待恒温水槽温度稳定后，使用体温计进行测量：
1. 体温计应处于用户模式，不要进入黑体模式；
2. 对被测水槽连续测量三次，不必关注屏幕显示的温度，只看背光颜色；
3. 要求：测试34℃水槽时背光应为白色，测试35.7℃水槽时背光应为橙色、测试37℃水槽时背光应为红色。
4. 对测试结果不符合规定的温度计，可复测两次，两次复测合格，亦可作合格处理。 | 见测试记录三 | 见测试记录三 | 合格 | |

source_text: 1\. 将恒温水槽设定在32℃、32.5℃、35℃、38.5℃、42℃、42.5℃、42.9℃，待恒温水槽温度稳定（ “稳定”的定义见“PT9L红外体温计产品检验标准”）后，使用PT9L计进行测量。每个温度点下测量三次，相邻两次测试间隔1分钟，测试过程中记录按键功能是否正常、蜂鸣器是否正常、屏幕显示是否正常、测量误差是否符合要求。

source_text: |  | 组装探头板 | 探头组装 | 1、传感器冲压模具 2、气动压力机 | 1.左手持1PCS温度传感器，右手使用偏口钳将传感器凸点减掉 2、将温度传感器装入散热金属套； 3、将散热金属套，装入压块 4、将安装好的探头，装入传感器压合工装内； 5、盖上传感器压合工装上盖； 6、将压合工装放置气动压合工装指定位置； 7、双手同时压下气动压合工装上的，两个按钮； 8、取出压合完成的传感器。 | 1、不得用手触摸传感器镜片； 2、剪点到位 3、外观无破损、脏污等不良 4、拿取传感器时，不得抓取传感器腿，以免造成传感器腿粘连、弯曲影响传感器板装配； 5、探头放置平稳； 6、压合后高度：14.1±0.1mm； 7、传感器、散热套无松动现象； 8、设备压力调节0.6±0.05MPa,时间调节在3±1秒； 9、拿取传感器时，不得抓取传感器腿，以免造成传感器腿粘连、弯曲影响传感器板装配。 | 关键工序 | 压合传感器 |

source_text: |  | 检测 | 主板贴片检测 | 1、工装：PT9L检测工装PT9L-CESHI； 2、电源：输出电压3±0.1V，最大输出电流500mA，电流指示精度0.01mA； 3、需佩戴静电手腕带。 | 1、上电后两个LED灯D1和D2全亮，屏幕显示CB1，然后显示软件版本号，2s后进入休眠，两个LED灯熄灭，显示黑屏，操作人员查看休眠电流，应小于30uA； 2、按下按键S1唤醒，两个LED点亮，LCD全显； 3、若自检全部通过，LCD显示“PAS”，按下按键S1保存，CB1完成； 4、若自检未通过，屏幕显示Er1。 | 程序自动检测电池电压，外部NTC，红外传感器的贴片情况，应该满足如下条件： a． 电池电压在2.7V到3.3V之间 b． 外部NTC温度在23℃到27℃之间（此处为10K的标准电阻） c． 红外传感器测温应在10℃到40℃之间 否则，LCD会显示ER1错误提示，此时按下按键会循环显示上面三个测量结果供查找问题。 | 关键工序 | 检测贴片的元件功能、性能、虚焊、连焊 |

source_text: | 取吸塑盒 |  | 手套 | 操作员将吸塑盒取出，一个一个分开放置到流水线上。 ![装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_016.png](装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx_assets/装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_016.png) | 1.吸塑盒不能有破损，褶皱，脏污、变形等缺陷 2.折叠时不能有撕裂，损坏 3.纸托架放置时要保持整齐 | 一般工序 |

source_text: | 整机装吸塑盒 |  | 手套 | 操作员先用气枪将整机透镜处和纸托盒内的异物出吹掉。再将整机放入纸托架内，注意安装方向，枪尾放在电池方向 ![装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_019.png](装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx_assets/装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_019.png) | 1.整机外观，无脏污、破损、划伤、咯伤、杂质、异物、色差、变形、凸起、凹陷、无毛刺、飞边等现象。 2.整机放入纸托架，注意安装方向。 | 一般工序 |

rel_path: 12 设计输出（含01、02）\设计输出清单二\装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx.clean.md
source_text: | 彩包装贴标签 |  | 手套 | 如图所示将标签粘贴到彩包装背面方框位置。 ![装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_023.png](装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx_assets/装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_023.png) | 标签粘贴的位置应正确，不可有脏污破损手印以及毛屑毛发等。 | 一般工序 |

rel_path: 12 设计输出（含01、02）\设计输出清单二\装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx.clean.md
source_text: | 彩包装整机称重 |  | 手套 | 将包装好的整机成品放到流水线上，由在线检重秤称重检查成品包装物料是否齐全，显示称重重量应合格（取检验包装完整的成品1台，使用在线检重动态称重学习5次，取5次称重重量平均值的±10g为合格），不合格剔除，由班组长确认检查，单一包装原材料重量＜5g的称重设备不能识别，由操作员自检和包装过程抽检控制。 ![装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_024.png](装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx_assets/装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_024.png) | HXW-400B型在线检重称显示重量应合格，检重称检重产品时应无连包报警现象。 | 一般工序 |

rel_path: 12 设计输出（含01、02）\设计输出清单二\装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx.clean.md
source_text: | 贴防拆签 |  | 手套 | 操作员将防拆签粘贴到包装盒左图的红圈位置（扣盖的中间位置）并压平，只可粘贴一层防拆签，粘贴后不可褶皱，无脏污、破损等现象。 ![装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_025.png](装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx_assets/装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_025.png) | 1.成品重量符合要求。 2.标签粘贴的位置应正确，不可有脏污破损手印以及毛屑毛发等。 | 一般工序 |

rel_path: 12 设计输出（含01、02）\设计输出清单二\装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx.clean.md
source_text: | 封外箱下盖 |  | 手套 | 如图所示使用透明胶带粘贴外箱，封箱外观应为工字形，胶带不可翘起。 ![装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_026.jpg](装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx_assets/装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_026.jpg) | 胶带完全粘贴到内箱上，胶带不可翘起。 | 一般工序 |

rel_path: 12 设计输出（含01、02）\设计输出清单二\装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx.clean.md
source_text: | 彩包装装外箱 |  | 手套 | 将包装盒放置到外箱内，方向保持一致，一层6台，4层，一箱放24台成品机器。 产品正面朝上。 ![装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_027.png](装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx_assets/装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_027.png) | 1.包装盒中装有机器 2.外箱中装入机器数量正确 3.包装盒表面无划伤、脏污、多料、少料、破损等外观不良 4.包装盒封口签外观正常 5.外箱表面无划伤、脏污、多料、少料、破损等外观不良 6.胶带完全粘贴到外箱上，胶带不可翘起。 7.24台包装盒标签与外箱标签内容一一对应。 | 一般工序 |

rel_path: 12 设计输出（含01、02）\设计输出清单二\装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx.clean.md
source_text: | 封外箱上盖 |  | 手套 | 如图所示使用透明胶带粘贴外箱，封箱外观应为工字形，胶带不可翘起遮盖外箱上文字等。 ![装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_026.jpg](装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx_assets/装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_026.jpg) | 封箱胶带完全粘贴到外箱上，胶带不可翘起遮盖外箱上文字等。 | 一般工序 |

rel_path: 12 设计输出（含01、02）\设计输出清单二\装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx.clean.md
source_text: | 外箱摆盘 |  | 手套 | 将封好的外箱放在价格标签秤上称重，显示称重重量应合格（合格重量范围：以首件报样的第一箱成品重量为标准，称重重量±0.1Kg为合格（尾数箱以实际重量为准），单一包装成品＜0.1Kg的称重设备不能识别，由操作员自检和包装过程抽检控制）,检验完成由检验员工填写《检测员工作日报》，由专人填写《修理日报表》。尾数箱操作(成品内箱和外箱需要手写箱号或毛净重标识的尾数箱，将按照尾数箱内产品实际数量或毛净重信息填写或修改（填写或修改信息清晰易辨认），保证尾数箱内产品数量或毛净重信息应与内箱和外箱标识信息一致。 ![装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_028.png](装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx_assets/装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_028.png) | 价格标签秤显示重量应合格。 | 一般工序 |

rel_path: 12 设计输出（含01、02）\设计输出清单二\装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx.clean.md
source_text: | 外箱摆盘 |  | 手套 | 如图所示将外箱摆放到塑料地盘上，摆放数量应统一，摆放高度不可超出电梯口高度，每完成整盘或尾数盘时，由领班核对成品外箱印刷的唯一性标识与操作作业指导书中外箱图纸印刷内容相同，确认无误后，依据实际生产的评审、机种、控制号等信息与生产计划相对应填写成品状态单标识，确认签字；状态单标识应不少于填写信息内容包括：成品控制号、机种、产品名称、数量、确认人、日期以及备注（评审、国家、类型、其他等），缠绕裹好膜，粘贴好状态单，放置待检区域。 ![装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_029.png](装配说明V1.0-PT9L.via_xlsx_assets/装配说明V1.0-PT9L_image_029.png) | 自检:摆放数量应统一，摆放高度不可超出电梯口高度，状态单标识应清晰。 | 一般工序 |

source_text: |  | 组装探头板 | 探头组装 | 1、传感器冲压模具 2、气动压力机 | 1.左手持1PCS温度传感器，右手使用偏口钳将传感器凸点减掉 2、将温度传感器装入散热金属套； 3、将散热金属套，装入压块 4、将安装好的探头，装入传感器压合工装内； 5、盖上传感器压合工装上盖； 6、将压合工装放置气动压合工装指定位置； 7、双手同时压下气动压合工装上的，两个按钮； 8、取出压合完成的传感器。 | 1、不得用手触摸传感器镜片； 2、剪点到位 3、外观无破损、脏污等不良 4、拿取传感器时，不得抓取传感器腿，以免造成传感器腿粘连、弯曲影响传感器板装配； 5、探头放置平稳； 6、压合后高度：14.1±0.1mm； 7、传感器、散热套无松动现象； 8、设备压力调节0.6±0.05MPa,时间调节在3±1秒； 9、拿取传感器时，不得抓取传感器腿，以免造成传感器腿粘连、弯曲影响传感器板装配。 | 关键工序 | 压合传感器 |

source_text:
| 13.注意事项和警告 | 安全预防措施
警告
使用本体温计不能代替咨询医生。如果你对体温读数有疑问，请咨询你的医生。
把体温计放在儿童够不到的地方。如果意外吞下电池或其他部件，请立即联系紧急服务。
电池不得投入明火或短路。
谨慎
(1)测量
1. 温度计读数应作为参考。不要尝试使用温度读数进行自我诊断或自我治疗。必要时请寻求专业医疗建议。
2. 人体体温没有绝对的标准。了解自己的正常体温范围对于准确判断自己是否发烧很重要。
3. 测量前，请确保受试者额头没有汗水、化妆品、污垢或油脂。
4. 在进行读数之前/期间，患者不应饮酒、饮食或进行身体活动。等待30分钟后测量。当一个物体处于稳定的平衡状态时所取的温度读数更准确，作为参考也更有用。
5. 不要在疤痕组织、开放性溃疡或擦伤处测量温度。
6. 不要从额头上的疤痕组织测量体温，因为这些组织会影响身体的温度传导。
7. 如果体温计存放区域与受试者周围的新环境存在温差，请将体温计放置在新环境中30分钟后再进行测量。
8. 服用升高体温的药物后，不要立即测量体温。此时所取的温度读数将不准确。
9. 从连续测量中获得的读数在小范围内波动是正常的。在连续测量过程中，受试者的体温可能会传递到体温计上，影响测量精度。我们建议在短时间内最多连续读数3次。
10. 在测量过程中，不要直接面对太阳或空调或散热器设备的出风口，因为这会导致额头温度的变化。测量应尽可能在稳定的环境中进行。
11. 请勿在电磁干扰较强的环境下测量体温(例如靠近微波炉、电磁炉或使用中的手机)，因为电磁干扰可能导致读数错误甚至设备故障。
12. 本产品应被视为个人设备。对产品进行清洁和消毒，防止交叉污染。
13. 清洁脏的温度计探头时，用棉签蘸70%异丙基轻

source_text: This product is a high-tech infra-red (IR) thermometer designed to take human body temperature by measuring the energy of IR emitted from the forehead. The product will help you to assess you and your family members’ health conditions easily and quickly.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages. It can be used by consumers in the household environment and by healthcare providers.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Use of this thermometer is not intended as a substitute for consultation with your physician. Please consult your doctor if you have any doubt about the temperature reading.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Keep the thermometer out of reach of children. For accidental swallowing of the battery or other components, please contact emergency services immediately.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 1\. Thermometer readings should be regarded as a reference. Do not attempt self-diagnostics or self-treatment using the temperature readings. Please seek professional medical advice when necessary.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 2\. There is no absolute standard for human body temperature. Knowing your own normal body temperature range is important to accurately determine if you have a fever.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 4\. After showering, bathing, exercising, and eating, wait forPatients should not drink, eat, or be physically active before/while taking a reading. Wait 30 minutes before taking a measurement. Temperature readings taken when a body is in a state of stable equilibrium is more accurate and useful as a reference.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 5\. Do not take temperature measurement over scar tissue, open sores or abrasions.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 6\. Do not measure body temperature from scar tissues on the forehead as such tissues will affect temperature conduction of the body.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 76\. If there is a temperature difference between the thermometer storage area and the new ambient environment around the subject, please let the thermometer sit within the newsubject’s ambient environment for 30 minutes before taking the measurement.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 87\. Do not measure body temperature immediately after consuming a drugtaking a medication that raises body temperature. Temperature readings taken at this time will not be accurate.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 98\. It is normal for readings taken from continuous measurements to fluctuate within a small range. During continuous measurements, the subject’s body temperature may be transmitted to the thermometer, affecting measurement accuracy. We recommend taking only up to 3 continuous readings within a short period.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 109\. Do not directly face the sun, or an air outlet of an air conditionering or radiator device during the measurement as this will cause changes to the forehead temperature. Measurements should be taken in a stable environment where possible.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 1110\. Do not measure body temperature in an environment with strong electromagnetic (EM) interferenceEM interference (examples include places close to a working microwave, induction cooker, or cellphone in-use) as EM interference interference may cause errors in the reading or even device failure.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Body temperature varies from person to person and fluctuates during the course of the day. For this reason, it is suggested to know one's normal, healthy forehead temperature to correctly determine the temperature.

rel_path: 历史记录\6.12说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Body temperature runs approximately from 95.9℉°F to100℉°F(35.5℃-37.8℃). To determine if one has a fever, compare the temperature detected with the person's normal temperature. A rise over the reference body temperature of 1.8℉(1℃) or more is generally an indication of a fever.

source_text: This product is a high-tech infra-red (IR) thermometer designed to take human body temperature by measuring the energy of IR emitted from the forehead. The product will help you to assess you and your family members’ health conditions easily and quickly.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages. It can be used by consumers in the household environment and by healthcare providers.

source_text: □ Use of this thermometer is not intended as a substitute for consultation with your physician. Please consult your doctor if you have any doubt about the temperature reading.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Keep the thermometer out of reach of children. For accidental swallowing of the battery or other components, please contact emergency services immediately.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 1\. Thermometer readings should be regarded as a reference. Do not attempt self-diagnostics or self-treatment using the temperature readings. Please seek professional medical advice when necessary.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 2\. There is no absolute standard for human body temperature. Knowing your own normal body temperature range is important to accurately determine if you have a fever.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 4\. After showering, bathing, exercising, and eating, wait forPatients should not drink, eat, or be physically active before/while taking a reading. Wait 30 minutes before taking a measurement. Temperature readings taken when a body is in a state of stable equilibrium is more accurate and useful as a reference.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 5\. Do not take temperature measurement over scar tissue, open sores or abrasions.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 6\. Do not measure body temperature from scar tissues on the forehead as such tissues will affect temperature conduction of the body.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 76\. If there is a temperature difference between the thermometer storage area and the new ambient environment around the subject, please let the thermometer sit within the newsubject’s ambient environment for 30 minutes before taking the measurement.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 87\. Do not measure body temperature immediately after consuming a drugtaking a medication that raises body temperature. Temperature readings taken at this time will not be accurate.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 98\. It is normal for readings taken from continuous measurements to fluctuate within a small range. During continuous measurements, the subject’s body temperature may be transmitted to the thermometer, affecting measurement accuracy. We recommend taking only up to 3 continuous readings within a short period.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 109\. Do not directly face the sun, or an air outlet of an air conditionering or radiator device during the measurement as this will cause changes to the forehead temperature. Measurements should be taken in a stable environment where possible.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 1110\. Do not measure body temperature in an environment with strong electromagnetic (EM) interferenceEM interference (examples include places close to a working microwave, induction cooker, or cellphone in-use) as EM interference interference may cause errors in the reading or even device failure.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Body temperature varies from person to person and fluctuates during the course of the day. For this reason, it is suggested to know one's normal, healthy forehead temperature to correctly determine the temperature.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.1说明书\PT9L-operation guide-20240801.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Body temperature runs approximately from 95.9℉°F to100℉°F(35.5℃-37.8℃). To determine if one has a fever, compare the temperature detected with the person's normal temperature. A rise over the reference body temperature of 1.8℉(1℃) or more is generally an indication of a fever.

source_text: □ Body temperature varies from person to person and fluctuates during the course of the day. For this reason, it is suggested to know one's normal, healthy forehead temperature to correctly determine the temperature.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: This product is a high-tech infra-red (IR) thermometer designed to take human body temperature by measuring the energy of IR emitted from the forehead. The product will help you to assess you and your family members’ health conditions easily and quickly.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: Product Model: PT9L

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages. It can be used by consumers in the household environment and by healthcare providers.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: ![图片 1](PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html_assets/PT9L-operation guide-20240828_html_7c7b504.png) Warning

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Use of this thermometer is not intended as a substitute for consultation with your physician. Please consult your doctor if you have any doubt about the temperature reading.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Keep the thermometer out of reach of children. For accidental swallowing of the battery or other components, please contact emergency services immediately.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: ![图片 2](PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html_assets/PT9L-operation guide-20240828_html_7c7b504.png) Caution

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 1\. Thermometer readings should be regarded as a reference. Do not attempt self-diagnostics or self-treatment using the temperature readings. Please seek professional medical advice when necessary.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 2\. There is no absolute standard for human body temperature. Knowing your own normal body temperature range is important to accurately determine if you have a fever.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 4\. After showering, bathing, exercising, and eating, wait for 30 minutes before taking a measurement. Temperature readings taken when a body is in a state of stable equilibrium is more accurate and useful as a reference.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (5) Do not take temperature measurement over scar tissue, open sores or abrasions as such tissues will affect temperature conduction of the body.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (6) If there is a temperature difference between the thermometer storage area and the ambient environment around the subject, please let the thermometer sit within the subject’s ambient environment for 30 minutes before taking the measurement.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (7) Do not measure body temperature immediately after taking a medication that raises body temperature. Temperature readings taken at this time will not be accurate.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (8) It is normal for readings taken from continuous measurements to fluctuate within a small range. During continuous measurements, the subject’s body temperature may be transmitted to the thermometer, affecting measurement accuracy. We recommend taking only up to 3 continuous readings within a short period.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (9) Do not directly face the sun, an air outlet of an air conditioner or radiator device during the measurement as this will cause changes to the forehead temperature. Measurements should be taken in a stable environment where possible.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: (10) Do not measure body temperature in an environment with strong electromagnetic (EM) interference (examples include places close to a working microwave, induction cooker, or cellphone in-use) as EM interference may cause errors in the reading or even device failure.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md

source_text: Insert the 2 batteries included in the package into the battery compartment at the back of the device. The product will perform a self-check then enter the standby mode (if the device indicates low battery power, replace the batteries to ensure ample power supply).

To measure a body's temperature, aim the thermometer probe at the center of the forehead and keep the probe 1.18 inch away from the forehead (About the same length as the first joint of your index finger). Do not touch the forehead with the probe and the thermometer should be held perpendicular to the forehead and the subject should remain steady.

A progress bar will be displayed on the screen throughout the measurement process. If you release the button before the process is complete, the result will not be displayed.

source_text: # Temperature-taking hints

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Body temperature varies from person to person and fluctuates during the course of the day. For this reason, it is suggested to know one's normal, healthy forehead temperature to correctly determine the temperature.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: □ Body temperature runs approximately from 95.9℉ to99.5℉(35.5℃-37.5℃). To determine if one has a fever, compare the temperature detected with the person's normal temperature. A rise over the reference body temperature of 1℉ or more is generally an indication of a fever.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: ② Allow the thermometer to dry for at least 5 minutes before taking a temperature.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: Do not put the thermometer under direct sunlight, high temperature, or moist environments. Do not allow it to come into contact with fire or harsh vibrations.

rel_path: 历史记录\8.28\PT9L-operation guide-20240828.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: Take out the battery if the device is not used for a month or more.

source_text: This product is a high-tech infra-red (IR) thermometer designed to take human body temperature by measuring the energy of IR emitted from the forehead. The product will help you to assess you and your family members’ health conditions easily and quickly.

source_text: The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages. It can be used by consumers in the household environment and by healthcare providers.

source_text: **Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer (PT9L)**

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: This product is a high-tech infra-red (IR) thermometer designed to take human body temperature by measuring the energy of IR emitted from the forehead. The product will help you to assess you and your family members' health conditions easily and quickly.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: Product Model: PT9L

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages. It can be used by consumers in the household environment and by healthcare providers.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: ![](_assets/media_PT9L说明书/media/image5.png)Warning

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: - Use of this thermometer is not intended as a substitute for consultation with your physician. Please consult your doctor if you have any doubt about the temperature reading.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: - Keep the thermometer out of reach of children. For accidental swallowing of the battery or other components, please contact emergency services immediately.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: ![](_assets/media_PT9L说明书/media/image5.png)Caution

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 1\. Thermometer readings should be regarded as a reference. Do not attempt self-diagnostics or self-treatment using the temperature readings. Please seek professional medical advice when necessary.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 2\. There is no absolute standard for human body temperature. Knowing your own normal body temperature range is important to accurately determine if you have a fever.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 4\. After showering, bathing, exercising, and eating, wait for 30 minutes before taking a measurement. Temperature readings taken when a body is in a state of stable equilibrium is more accurate and useful as a reference.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 5\. Do not take temperature measurement over scar tissue, open sores or abrasions as such tissues will affect temperature conduction of the body.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 6\. If there is a temperature difference between the thermometer storage area and the ambient environment around the subject, please let the thermometer sit within the subject's ambient environment for 30 minutes before taking the measurement.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 7\. Do not measure body temperature immediately after taking a medication that raises body temperature. Temperature readings taken at this time will not be accurate.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 8\. It is normal for readings taken from continuous measurements to fluctuate within a small range. During continuous measurements, the subject's body temperature may be transmitted to the thermometer, affecting measurement accuracy. source_text: The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages. It can be used by consumers in the household environment and by healthcare providers.

source_text: □ Use of this thermometer is not intended as a substitute for consultation with your physician. Please consult your doctor if you have any doubt about the temperature reading.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 1\. Thermometer readings should be regarded as a reference. Do not attempt self-diagnostics or self-treatment using the temperature readings. Please seek professional medical advice when necessary.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 2\. There is no absolute standard for human body temperature. Knowing your own normal body temperature range is important to accurately determine if you have a fever.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 4\. After showering, bathing, exercising, and eating, wait forPatients should not drink, eat, or be physically active before/while taking a reading. Wait 30 minutes before taking a measurement. Temperature readings taken when a body is in a state of stable equilibrium is more accurate and useful as a reference.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 5\. Do not take temperature measurement over scar tissue, open sores or abrasions.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 6\. Do not measure body temperature from scar tissues on the forehead as such tissues will affect temperature conduction of the body.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 76\. If there is a temperature difference between the thermometer storage area and the new ambient environment around the subject, please let the thermometer sit within the newsubject’s ambient environment for 30 minutes before taking the measurement.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 87\. Do not measure body temperature immediately after consuming a drugtaking a medication that raises body temperature. Temperature readings taken at this time will not be accurate.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 98\. It is normal for readings taken from continuous measurements to fluctuate within a small range. During continuous measurements, the subject’s body temperature may be transmitted to the thermometer, affecting measurement accuracy. We recommend taking only up to 3 continuous readings within a short period.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 109\. Do not directly face the sun, or an air outlet of an air conditionering or radiator device during the measurement as this will cause changes to the forehead temperature. Measurements should be taken in a stable environment where possible.

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\T1样机\PT9L-operation guide-20240607.via_lo_html.clean.md

| 13.注意事项和警告 | 1. 受测者应避免于运动或沐浴后30分钟内进行量测，若有此状况则请受测者于恒温环境下静待5分钟以后再行量测。
2. 长时间不用本品时，应将电池取出。
3. 电池请勿充电或丢入火中，请将废弃的电池弃于指定的回收地点。请更换指定型号的电池，使用其它型号电池可能会导致起火或爆炸。
4. 产品寿命结束后或者准备报废时，请把电池取出单独处理，送到指定回收地点。尽可能把本品送到回收站处理。
5. 存放电池请远离儿童。
6. 本额式体温计非易燃物品。
7. 本额式体温计非AP或APG产品。
8. 本额式体温计为IPX0产品。
9. 本额式体温计连续运行。 | （一）关于测量
1. 体温计数值仅供参考，请勿依据测量结果进行自我诊断和治疗，必要时请前往医院就医。
2. 人体温度无绝对标准值，为了对发烧情况作出正确的判断，了解自己的正常体温很重要，这有助于对比判断发烧与否。
3. 测量前，请确保被测者前额没有汗水、化妆品、油渍等。
4. 测量前，请确保被测者在30分钟内没有洗澡、运动或用餐，身体处于稳定状态时所测得的体温更具有参考性。
5. 请勿在额头上有开放的或发炎的伤口部位测量。
6. 请勿在额头上有疤痕的位置测量，因为疤痕的结缔组织会影响体内温度的传导。
7. 如果体温计的存放处与被测者所处的新环境有温差，请将体温计在被测者所在的新环境中静置30分钟，使其达到平衡后再进行测量。
8. 请勿在服用了有可能会提高体温的药物后立即测量体温，因为此时的体温不具有参考性。
9. 连续测量时，测量结果有可能会出现微小误差，这属于正常现象。因为连续多次测量时，测量者的体温会传导到体温计进而影响测量准确性。我们推荐您在一个单位时间内最多连续测量三次。

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\附件1：TZ1准确度的验证报告.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 在试验前后，参考体温计的实验室准确度应使用水浴来验证。

rel_path: 历史记录\PT9LDHF-草稿\附件1：TZ1准确度的验证报告.via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: 测温前擦拭干净患者腋下皮肤（应以干毛巾擦拭，以免影响测量结果），将体温计水银端放于腋窝深处紧贴皮肤，嘱其屈臂过胸，将体温计夹紧，5-10分钟后取出，查看读数并记录，将水银柱甩至35℃以下。

source_text: - **用户测量流程**：单片机 ADC 采集外部 NTC、红外传感器的环境温度和物体温度。当环境温度在允许测量范围以内时，采集红外传感器的温度值并优化，通过环境温度值和物体温度值计算出人体实际的温度值。

rel_path: 历史记录\给实验室\PT9L-软件方案设计E0  23.11.doc.md
source_text: - **UE 模式**：UE 模式下对传感器的值进行实时读取与显示，包括电池电压、内部 NTC 的温度值、阻值、红外传感器电压、AD 值。按下按键，切换采集的参数。

rel_path: 历史记录\给实验室\PT9L-软件方案设计E0  23.11.doc.md
source_text: - **UE2 模式**：UE2 模式下，单片机读取 EEPROM 中保存的标定和校准参数，以及软件版本信息和硬件版本信息，并进行显示。按下按键，切换显示的参数。

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 1\. Thermometer readings should be regarded as a reference. Do not attempt self-diagnostics or self-treatment using the temperature readings. Please seek professional medical advice when necessary.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 2\. There is no absolute standard for human body temperature. Knowing your own normal body temperature range is important to accurately determine if you have a fever.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 4\. After showering, bathing, exercising, and eating, wait for 30 minutes before taking a measurement. Temperature readings taken when a body is in a state of stable equilibrium is more accurate and useful as a reference.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 5\. Do not take temperature measurement over scar tissue, open sores or abrasions as such tissues will affect temperature conduction of the body.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 6\. If there is a temperature difference between the thermometer storage area and the ambient environment around the subject, please let the thermometer sit within the subject's ambient environment for 30 minutes before taking the measurement.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 7\. Do not measure body temperature immediately after taking a medication that raises body temperature. Temperature readings taken at this time will not be accurate.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 8\. It is normal for readings taken from continuous measurements to fluctuate within a small range. During continuous measurements, the subject's body temperature may be transmitted to the thermometer, affecting measurement accuracy. We recommend taking only up to 3 continuous readings within a short period.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 9\. Do not directly face the sun, an air outlet of an air conditioner or radiator device during the measurement as this will cause changes to the forehead temperature. Measurements should be taken in a stable environment where possible.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 10\. Do not measure body temperature in an environment with strong electromagnetic (EM) interference (examples include places close to a working microwave, induction cooker, or cellphone in-use) as EM interference may cause errors in the reading or even device failure.

It displays subject's temperature over a range of 89.6℉\~109.2℉(32℃-42.9℃). Full responsibility for the conformance of this product to the standard is assumed.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: 15\. ASTM laboratory accuracy requirements in the display range of 37 to 39°C (98 to 102°F) for IR thermometers is ±0.2 °C (±0.4°F), whereas for mercury-in-glass and electronic thermometers, the requirement per ASTM Standards E667-86 and E1112-86 is ±0.1 °C (±0.2°F).

source_text: [19.]{.mark} It takes 6 hours for the thermometer to cool from the maximum storage temperature between uses until the thermometer is ready for its intended use when the ambient temperature is 20℃

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: - Body temperature varies from person to person and fluctuates during the course of the day. For this reason, it is suggested to know one\'s normal, healthy forehead temperature to correctly determine the temperature.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md
source_text: - Body temperature runs approximately from 95.9℉ to100℉(35.5℃-37.8℃). To determine if one has a fever, compare the temperature detected with the person\'s normal temperature. A rise over the reference body temperature of 1.8℉(1℃) or more is generally an indication of a fever.

rel_path: 历史记录\说明书文件\PT9L说明书.docx.md

source_text: This report, formulated according to the Guiding Principles for Technical Review of the Expected Life Registration of Active Medical Devices and IEC 62506: 2013 Methods for product accelerated testing, aims to verify the Expected Life of the the Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer model PT9L.

rel_path: 实验报告\最终报告\Analysis and Evaluation Report o...Touch Forehead Thermometer（PT9L） (1).via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: The Expected Life of the the Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer model PT9L is preset to 5 years. Verification of the aforementioned content is done through testing and analysis.

rel_path: 实验报告\最终报告\Analysis and Evaluation Report o...Touch Forehead Thermometer（PT9L） (1).via_lo_html.clean.md
source_text: The product mainly uses the environment for the home environment, which is the high-tech the Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer to measure the human body temperature by receiving the infrared energy of the human body forehead. The Expected Life is 5 years. The product mainly consists of a plastic casing, IR temperature sensor, MCU, LCD display screen，buzzer and batteries. The host is a critical factor influencing the overall product expected life. The product lifespan is confirmed through accelerated life testing of the entire unit. The evaluation follows the path of direct verification on the product.
